tool.name: mumemto merge
tool.command:
## Symlink all MUM files #for $i, $mf in enumerate($mum_files): ln -s '$mf' 'mum_${i}.mums' && #end for
mumemto merge #for $i, $mf in enumerate($mum_files):#if $i > 0:,#end ifmum_${i}.mums#end for #if $mums_of_mums: --merged_mums '$mums_of_mums' #end if --output 'merged.mums'

param.name: mum_files
param.label: MUM files
param.help: Two or more .mums files to merge. Each must have an associated .thresh file.

param.label: MUMs-of-MUMs file
param.help: Optional MUMs-of-MUMs file for incremental merging.

tool.help:
**What it does**
Merges multiple MUM partition files into a single consolidated MUMs file. This is used when mumemto was run in partition mode (with `-M`) to produce `.thresh` files alongside each `.mums` file.
**Input**
- Two or more `.mums` files (each with an associated `.thresh` file) - Optionally, a MUMs-of-MUMs file for incremental merging
**Output**
A merged `.mums` file combining all partitions.
